column1: # The psql-oracle corpus: the PostgreSQL 17.9 regression SQL files, frozen
# by Git blob ID, as the differential corpus is (docs/differential-baseline.md).
# The tests read each blob from the vendor/postgres object store, never from
# the checked-out tree, so a move of an oracle pin does not change the corpus.
# One file is left out: collate.windows.win1252.sql is WIN1252, not
# UTF-8. psql lexes it with a WIN1252 client encoding, where psqlscan.l
# substitutes 0xFF for the trailing bytes of a multibyte character
# (psqlscan_int.h). pg-psql reads Rust `&str`, so the two cannot be
# compared over it. The SQL differential corpus leaves out the four
# collate.* files too, for a different reason.
